NER.note: No exchange between civil register and ID system is stated.

facts.fact: The DGATDD says about 3,000,000 of the 13 million Nigeriens old enough for the national ID card do not yet hold one, so about 10 million hold one, roughly 36% of the 27.9 million population (derived by dividing by the stated population).

NER.note: A unique number is promised eventually for each citizen, not at birth registration.
Operation and ownership of the system are not stated.
No public register keyed on the ID number is stated.

facts.fact: The Governor and the DGATDD say the restructuring has entered its operational phase, with biometric enrolment, a National Population Register whose first phase starts in Niamey, a new biometric national ID card, and three decrees creating the ANEI.
facts.system: Registre National de la Population / CNI biometrique
